name: kulludo
description: KulLUDO — Ludo for Android & iOS (Capacitor) with free online rooms on Cloudflare

scripts.android: node scripts/prepare-native.mjs android && npx cap open android
scripts.ios: node scripts/prepare-native.mjs ios && npx cap open ios
scripts.server:dev: cd server && npm install && npx wrangler dev
scripts.server:deploy: cd server && npm install && npx wrangler deploy
